It loses a small amount of [[Slash]] damage in exchange of a larger amount of [[Fire]] and [[Frost]] damage. An upgraded Nord Sword will '''NOT''' keep its upgrade level when it is modified using essences. Its primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. No damage penalty against multiple targets.
